# Teen Patti Stars Agents

> Teen Patti Stars is a Teen Patti (3 Patti) card-game app for players in India. This site is for people who want to become a Teen Patti Stars agent: it explains the Big Agency Plan, how commission is earned, how to join, how to install the app, and it holds guides to Teen Patti and other card and casino games.

Facts as stated on the site (check the linked pages for the current wording):
- Agents earn commission, shown as "up to 70%" revenue share, based on the net profit of the players they refer. The home page works through an example with a 50% negative profit-sharing ratio.
- Joining as an agent is free. Agents track referred players and earnings on a platform dashboard and receive a unique referral code.
- The app is installed as an Android APK from the official site; the home page lists the installation steps.
- The games are for people aged 18 and over and are not offered in Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Orissa and Nagaland. The site encourages responsible play.
